To Whomsoever It May Concern,
This letter is issued at the request of National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. to confirm that the said agency has
executed work for this organisation as detailed below and that their performance has been found satisfactory.
1. Project Details
Project Name
Steel Truss Bridge — Gujarat Pkg-112

Large Bridges works for Trishakti Power Generation Corporation
completed 2019.

Large Bridges

2. Performance Assessment
Throughout the engagement the agency's conduct was cooperative, with weekly progress reporting
maintained without prompting, and . On that basis the agency has been placed on our approved-agency list
for this class of work.
Criterion
Rating
Observation
Adherence to Schedule
Excellent
Project delivered within contractual timeline
Quality of Work
Excellent
Workmanship meets or exceeds specifications
Safety Record
Good
BOCW Act compliance maintained throughout
Responsiveness
Excellent
Prompt resolution of site issues and RFIs
Financial Integrity
Good
Billing was accurate and supported by records
3. Recommendation
National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the sanctioned time and cost, and their
conduct on site was professional throughout. We would consider them for similar works.

We have no hesitation in recommending National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for similar assignments in the
future. This reference is valid for a period of High from the date of this letter.

For any verification or further information, please contact the undersigned at +91-9830000000 or ee@dept.gov.in. This letter is issued

Meera Bose
